fee_notes: Standard fee is $50,000. During 2025, fees ranged from $0 to $60,000 due to waivers/discounts. Franchise Option Program refunds fee in exchange for +4% royalty for 10 years. Military/First Responder: 20% discount. Multi-unit (3+): 25% off 2nd+ units. Hard-to-serve markets: up to 10% off.
raw_excerpt: You will pay us an initial franchise fee of $50,000. During 2025 our franchise offering included waivers, discounts and refunds such that our Initial Franchise Fees ranged from $0 to $60,000.
